author: codex-root

findings.summary: The standalone Quick Search trigger is rendered as an anchor acting as a button.
findings.consequence: The control is currently keyboard-operable through manual handlers, but it duplicates native button semantics and can drift from expected button behavior for future disabled, form, or interaction states.
findings.evidence: The owned template beginning at line 398 contains a non-navigating `Snabbsökning` trigger rendered as `<a role="button" tabindex="0">` with click, Enter, and Space handlers. Direct caller `SiteShell.vue` uses the same pattern, and existing SSR/behavior tests pin role-button accessibility rather than native button semantics.
findings.recommendation: Render the trigger as `<button type="button" class="quick-search-trigger">Snabbsökning</button>`, keep the click handler, title, and ref, and remove manual Enter/Space handlers unless a parity test proves custom behavior is still required.
